question: What identity belongs to the supreme magician who manifests manifoldly in the arena of dispute?
premises: The subject is identified as this supreme magician.
That same subject is described as some indescribable being.
This being displays itself in many ways within the arena of dispute.
inference: The supreme, indescribable magician is the one who manifests manifold appearances in the contested field of experience.
uncertainties: Whether vivādaraṅgaṃ refers to philosophical debate, worldly conflict, or the play of opposing principles is not explicit.
plain_english: This supreme magician, that indescribable one, having displayed himself in many ways in the arena of dispute.
